questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Rahul sings / very sweet / when he is / in a good mood
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'very sweet'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__Here** 'sweet' **is an adjective which qualifies a subject (Noun/ Pronoun)
 
• However, an 'adverb' is required to modify a Verb
 
 
• Example- Phillip **sings loudly** in the shower. 
 
 
 
• Thus, **'sweet**' will be replaced by** 'sweetly'.**

 

**Correct Sentence- **Rahul sings very sweetly when he is in a good mood.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

She had resign / from the / post before / he apologised.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "she had resign"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When two actions happen in the past, it is necessary to emphasize which action happened before the other.
 
 
• For example: I had gone (3rd form of verb) to Goa before my father came.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, the person putting in the resign before the other apologised. So here 3rd form of verb will be used i.e. resigned. 
 
• The correct sentence is: **She had resigned from the post before he apologised. **

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 1". **

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

After / a long and fun-filled day, / the children / slept themselves peacefully.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'slept themselves peacefully'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• 'Themselves' is a **reflexive pronoun**.
 
• A reflexive pronoun is used with these words like absented, pride, acquitted, etc.
 
 
• Example: I **pride** myself on being his son.
 
 
 
• The verb 'slept' doesn't take a reflexive pronoun.
 
• **Hence, the use of 'reflexive pronoun' is incorrect after 'slept'.**

**Therefore,** the correct sentence is:** *After a long and fun-filled day, the children slept peacefully*.**

questions.question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

a) is credited with saying

b) do not dry your feet

c) If you want to leave your footprint on the sands of time,

d) Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, former President of India
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'DACB'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a **Para Jumble.**
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually **an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, etc**.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence and independent of all the other sentences.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because '**credited with saying'** is directly connected with the first sentence.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because it tells the '**action'** connect with the previous one.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence B** will be used.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, former President of India is credited with saying If you want to leave your footprint on the sands of time, do not dry your feet.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The writer declares that __________ children of their childhood is a criminal act.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Robbing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that the author claims that depriving kids of their youth is wrong.
 
• In this context, the word that must fit the blank should be a **gerund.**
 
• A gerund is a part of speech that acts as a noun, but has a 'V+ ing' form.
 
 
• For example: He said that **smoking** is bad for health. (Here, 'smoking' is a gerund)
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, 'smoking' must fit the blank as it is used after 'that' (which introduces a restrictive clause).

Therefore, the correct answer is '*The writer declares that **robbing **children of their childhood is a criminal act'.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• Let us understand the participles:
 
 
• **Participles** are made of the verb which works as an **adjective**. **Participles** qualify the noun and pronoun.

 
 
• Present Participle -** V⁴ (V¹+ing)**
 
• Past Participle - **V³**
 
• Perfect Participle - **having + V³**
